name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - ready_for_review
    branches:
      - main

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  code-check:
    if: github.event.pull_request.draft == false
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install uv and set up Python
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
        with:
          enable-cache: false
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Run pre-commit hooks
        uses: pre-commit/action@v3.0.1

  pytest-linux:
    if: github.event.pull_request.draft == false
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
        matrix:
            python-version: ["3.12", "3.13"]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Install uv and set up Python
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
        with:
          enable-cache: false
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: uv sync --no-dev --all-extras

      - name: Start Ollama server
        run: curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh && ollama serve &

      - name: Test with pytest
        run: uv run pytest
        env:
          HUGGINGFACE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.HUGGINGFACE_API_KEY }}
          HF_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HUGGINGFACE_API_KEY }}
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}
          XAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.XAI_API_KEY }}

      - name: Delete EuroEval cache
        run: rm -rf .euroeval_cache

  pytest-macos:
    if: github.event.pull_request.draft == false && contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'macos')
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Install uv and set up Python
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
        with:
          enable-cache: false
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: uv sync --no-dev --all-extras

      - name: Start Ollama server
        run: curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh && ollama serve &

      - name: Test with pytest
        run: uv run pytest -vvv
        env:
          HUGGINGFACE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.HUGGINGFACE_API_KEY }}
          HF_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HUGGINGFACE_API_KEY }}
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}
          XAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.XAI_API_KEY }}

      - name: Delete EuroEval cache
        run: rm -rf .euroeval_cache

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
